title: EduGuardBench: A Holistic Benchmark for Evaluating the Pedagogical Fidelity and Adversarial Safety of LLMs as Simulated Teachers
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on pedagogical fidelity and adversarial safety in educational contexts, specifically assessing teaching harms (Incompetence, Offensiveness, Indolence) and safety vulnerabilities to persona-based adversarial prompts related to general harms and academic misconduct.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
